design_quote: Randomized controlled trials (RCTs) on fluoroquinolone antibiotics for uncomplicated PID were retrieved from online databases up to July 8, 2024.
k_quote: Fourteen studies were included, comprising a total of 2483 patients with PID
reason: Abstract frames the review as RCTs retrieved and screened, with Cochrane RCT RoB applied; 14 included trials.
